messages:
maria: Heads up — AV team spotted intermittent HDMI dropout in the main room during the final rehearsal. If it flakes during the live call we should switch to backup laptop + USB capture.

sachin: noted. I can have the spare laptop ready on table B with the USB-C capture. Do we want to mirror slides there or stream it?

jordan: mirror slides + local recording. streaming from spare adds another network dependency.

elaine: can someone confirm who will handle post-allhands followups? I can collate Qs but need a point person for action items.

marta: I’ll own leadership followups. Please tag any backlog items w/ #allhands-followup and assign to me for first pass.

maria: thanks — action plan: 1) spare laptop on table B w/ HDMI->USB capture, 2) OBS scene preloaded with two sources (slides + camera), 3) local file recording to external SSD.

austin: adding OBS fallback details — use the secondary profile we tested. Command to pull failsafe scene is: 
```
obs-cli --profile fallback --scene "Allhands Backup" --start-recording --output /media/ssd/allhands-$(date +%s).mkv
```

sachin: copy that. I’ll prep the SSD and test the command once at 10:15.

maria: Captioning: caption-bot will run on the live stream but have a manual VTT export ready in case of disconnect. caption-bot: any special notes?

caption-bot: running with en-US model, 1s latency target. If transcription drops, export step: Settings -> Export -> Save VTT.

elaine: Q&A workflow — during live Q&A please put all audience submitted questions into the #allhands-questions doc (linked below) so we don’t lose them after the call. I’ll triage and send to Marta for answers.

jordan: Slack reminder to attendees at T-5 to submit questions into that doc. I’ll post it.

marta: quick note for answers — keep public answers high level, follow ups can be handled offline. If something requires engineering bandwidth, tag @sachin and @jordan.

maria: last-minute checklist for ops: spare laptop ready, SSD formatted (ext4), OBS fallback profile loaded, backup recording started before official start, captions running, handoff doc link shared.

sachin: SSD formatted and labeled. Doing a dry-run record now, will attach the log after.

maria: log snippet from dry-run:
```
[10:18:02] obs: profile loaded: fallback
[10:18:03] obs: scene init: Allhands Backup
[10:18:04] recorder: writing /media/ssd/allhands-1700000000.mkv
```

elaine: great. one more: capture who asked each leadership question during Q&A so followups are traceable. can we add a column in the doc for 'asked by'?

marta: yes please. also ping me if there's any customer or partner-related question so I can loop in sales.

maria: final — I’ll be on-site and will confirm readiness at T-2. If the HDMI drops, switch to USB capture and shout here. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks team — will post the doc link now.

caption-bot: reminder set: at T-5 will post captions status in thread.

marta: thanks all. Let’s keep the runbook simple and avoid juggling multiple streams unless needed.
